recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-14699 unless a future ballot intentionally revisits ValueSet $validate-code input parameter requirements.
issue_request: FHIR-14699 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for the STU3 ValueSet $validate-code operation wording. It requested replacing the nonexistent in parameter "constraint" with url, context, or valueSet, and also required wording that exactly one of code, coding, or codeableConcept must be provided.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in git-svn commit d90f55e1cbc897c77c5188342e1d43353f38f2c3, corresponding to SVN build@13351. That commit included GF#14699 and changed the old ValueSet spreadsheet $validate-code description from "constraint"/"valueset" to "url, context or valueSet" and from parenthesized code inputs to "code, coding, or codeableConcept". Later source rework carried the operation text into source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists valueset=ValueSet under [resources], so the source/valueset OperationDefinition files are in current build scope. The adjacent ValueSet $expand operation carries the same corrected url/context/valueSet wording from the same 2018 terminology block-vote family. FHIR-33941 later updated $validate-code output guidance and normalized spacing while preserving the FHIR-14699 input wording. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence; the Vocabulary block-vote page lists tracker 14699 as Persuasive with Modification and pre-applied.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml already says that url, context or valueSet must be provided when not called at instance level, and that one and only one of code, coding, or codeableConcept must be provided. Source searches found no remaining bad "constraint"/"valueset" wording in the relevant ValueSet operation sources.

related_jiras.note: The same 2018 terminology block-vote batch corrected analogous ValueSet $expand wording about the nonexistent "constraint" input parameter.
This later $validate-code update added output-parameter guidance and normalized spacing while preserving the FHIR-14699 corrected input wording.
